_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.123 — Schedule XV para 1(f): "contribution by an employee to a recognised provident fund" (Gazette 265620, p.561). D-130. Withheld from pay, hence SALARIES (D-130 C2a); not salary income. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80C(2)(vi) (thc p.330): "as a contribution by an employee to a recognised provident fund". sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md; D-144.
displayName: Your contribution to a recognised provident fund
head: SALARIES

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-22082025-265620, Income-tax Act, 2025 Schedule XV para 1(f), p.561; s.123, p.159; Income-tax Act, 1961 as on thc.nic.in (current to Act 7 of 2019), s.80C(2)(vi), p.330

terms.terms: The whole balance: on retirement after the age of fifty-five; on retirement for permanent and total incapacity; before migrating abroad; on retrenchment or a voluntary retirement scheme; otherwise on ceasing to be an employee, after twelve months out of covered employment. These are the terms of the fund the EPFO runs; an exempted establishment's fund has its own rules.

provenance.sourceDescription: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, G.S.R. 525(E), Gazette Part II s.3(i) No. 473 of 29-06-2026, CG-DL-E-01072026-273957, para. 49(1), (2), p.89

terms.terms: At least one thousand rupees, up to the whole balance above a minimum balance of 25% of all contributions (the employee's and the employer's, with interest), after twelve months' membership: for illness, for education (at most ten times), for marriage (five times), for housing (five times), and in special circumstances (twice in a financial year).

provenance.sourceDescription: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, G.S.R. 525(E), Gazette Part II s.3(i) No. 473 of 29-06-2026, CG-DL-E-01072026-273957, para. 46, p.87

unstated.reason: The Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 governed until the 2026 Scheme superseded it; the pack holds no Gazette copy of it to read its terms from (W-238e2)
